Strongest arena record in the batch (Elo 1316, 339-224-6). The PSF is full for D14 and the listing is somewhat opaque (null built_year, generic name, compact 1023 sqft for a 3BR).
agent_evaluation.rating_rationale: Several investment positives align: freehold tenure, a $2.0M quantum at the heart of the liquid sweet spot, 300m walkable to Aljunied MRT (East-West Line), a recognized primary-school catchment that sustains family demand, and Paya Lebar Central regeneration as a district catalyst. The arena agrees — best Elo (1316) and win record (339-224-6) in the batch. Caveats: $1955 PSF is on the full side for D14/Geylang and the listing lacks a built_year and project name, so this is a conviction on the location/tenure/quantum profile rather than a specific verified project. Net positive enough for a Buy at medium confidence.
red_flags: $1955 PSF is full for D14/Geylang — limited value cushion
Null built_year and generic listing name — specific project/age unverified
1023 sqft is compact for a 3BR — efficient but could be a 'small 3BR' that rents/sells closer to a large 2BR
No URA appreciation/txn data to confirm trend
catalysts: Freehold + $2.0M quantum in the deepest liquidity band — broad buyer appeal
300m to Aljunied MRT (EWL) — strong walkable connectivity to CBD and Paya Lebar
Within 1km of Kong Hwa Primary — durable school-catchment demand
Paya Lebar Central commercial regeneration and airbase relocation lift D14 over the next decade
agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: 3BR near Aljunied MRT and the city fringe rents well to families and sharers; gross yield ~3.3-3.6% at $2.0M. Wide tenant pool given MRT proximity and CBD access.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: No project URA series, but freehold + walkable MRT + school catchment + Paya Lebar regeneration supports an above-RCR-edge view; model ~4.5%, with the full entry PSF as the main limiter.
